dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Garden is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Recently, Garden was returned to the care center due to a bite incident that took place in the home. Garden lunged at and bit an unfamiliar person in the home on their abdomen. During his previous stay in the care center Garden was observed to be fearful and would refuse walks on the street. With familiar handlers, Garden presents with a soft body and allows contact. Medically, Garden is apparently healthy.

Garden was recently returned to the care center due to a bite incident that took place in the home. A friend of the owner was in the home when Garden was being removed from his crate to be taken on a walk. After sniffing the unfamiliar person, Garden then bit them on the left side of their abdomen. This bite was a bite and hold that broke skin. During his previous stay in the care center, Garden was observed to be fearful and would refuse to walk on the street. Due to the detailed behavior and bite incident, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
